# The Pack Hub

> The Pack Hub is a packaging company in India, established in 2022 and based in Delhi. It is a manufacturer, exporter and supplier of bakery and food packaging, including baking paper cups, laddu paper cups, food wrapping paper, printed cake boxes, cake base boards, pastry bases and paper moulds, with custom printing and bulk supply.

The Pack Hub supplies bakeries, sweet shops, cafes, cloud kitchens, food manufacturers, confectionery professionals, distributors, large retailers and home bakers. It serves Delhi NCR and customers across India, and also exports to international buyers. Its range is built around paper and paperboard products, and it offers custom size, colour and logo printing.
